entries.title: Import missing symbol
entries.description: Add or update an import/include/using/use statement for a missing symbol.

entries.title: Declare missing symbol
entries.description: Create a declaration or definition for a referenced symbol.

entries.title: Rename reference
entries.description: Change a reference to an existing symbol with a close match.

entries.title: Adjust type annotation
entries.description: Change a type annotation, generic argument, interface, or bound.

entries.title: Convert value
entries.description: Insert an explicit conversion, cast, parse, unwrap, await, or adaptation.

entries.title: Add missing argument
entries.description: Add a required call argument.

entries.title: Remove extra argument
entries.description: Remove an unsupported or excess call argument.

entries.title: Rename argument
entries.description: Change a named argument, property, field, or parameter label.

entries.title: Add dependency
entries.description: Add a dependency to a manifest, lockfile, project file, or build file.

entries.title: Update dependency
entries.description: Change a dependency version, feature, classifier, target, or constraint.

entries.title: Adjust configuration option
entries.description: Change a compiler, linter, analyzer, formatter, or build option.

entries.title: Insert missing token
entries.description: Insert a punctuation, keyword, delimiter, terminator, or syntactic marker.

entries.title: Remove invalid token
entries.description: Remove a token that violates the language grammar.

entries.title: Apply formatter
entries.description: Run a formatter or apply formatter-generated text edits.

entries.title: Apply linter fix
entries.description: Apply a linter-provided fix or suggestion.

entries.title: Update test expectation
entries.description: Update a test expectation, assertion, fixture, golden file, or snapshot. This is review-required by default.

entries.title: Fix code under test
entries.description: Change product code to satisfy an existing test.

entries.title: Declare capability
entries.description: Add or update a declared permission, effect, capability, import, or policy.

entries.title: Remove secret
entries.description: Remove a hardcoded credential or secret and replace it with a safe reference.

entries.title: Manual repair required
entries.description: No safe automated repair is known.
